name: Control Possession 4-2-3-1

slots.why: Sweeper keeper is the extra outfield player in build-up and covers the space behind the higher line.
Support full-back offers a passing option wide and provides width without leaving the team open.
Ball-playing defender starts moves with progressive passes through the opposition's press.
Central defender who defends while his partner plays. Cover is the alternate.
Support full-back on the right, doing the same job as on the left.
Holding midfielder protects the back line and gives the playmaker beside him the freedom to pass.
Deep-lying playmaker is the team's main passer and sets the tempo from deep.
Inside forward comes inside onto his stronger foot, so the wide areas are left to the full-back and the other winger.
Advanced playmaker is the creative centre of the team and finds passes between the lines.
Winger (Support) stays wide and gives the team a wide outlet and something to stretch the opponent.
Lone striker: Advanced Forward runs in behind, Poacher stays in the box.

description: A patient 4-2-3-1 that controls territory and circulates until space opens between or outside the opposition lines.
whyGood: The double pivot gives secure circulation while the AP and wide attackers provide several receiving lines ahead of the ball.
whyThisShape: A 4-2-3-1 built to keep the ball: a double pivot behind three attacking midfielders, with a sweeper keeper and ball-playing defender starting moves from the back. The aim is to dominate possession and wear the opponent down rather than to break quickly.
whenToUse: When your squad is technically better than the opponent's and you expect them to sit deep, or when you want to protect a lead by keeping the ball.
whenNotToUse: Against a well-organised high press if your defenders and pivot are not calm on the ball, and when you need goals quickly: lower tempo makes it slow to change the game.

instructionRationale.Shorter Passing: Keeps possession in short passes rather than risking it with long balls.
instructionRationale.Lower Tempo: Slows the game down so the team can control it and rest with the ball.
instructionRationale.Play Out Of Defence: The sweeper keeper and ball-playing defender make building from the back safe.
instructionRationale.Work Ball Into Box: Patient movement of the ball until a clear chance opens up.
instructionRationale.Hold Shape: Keeps positions rather than pushing players forward, so the team stays balanced while it keeps the ball.
instructionRationale.Standard Line of Engagement: A balanced press: does not chase the ball wildly and lose the shape.
instructionRationale.Higher Defensive Line: Keeps the team compact around the ball and squeezes the space for the opponent.
